title: limonium brassicifolium subsp. macropterum
intro: Limonium brassicifolium subsp. macropterum, commonly known as Sea Lavender, is a plant species that belongs to the Plumbaginaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, and research has shown that Sea Lavender possesses several health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which can help to protect against cell damage, reduce inflammation, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of Sea Lavender include its ability to soothe and calm the nervous system, promote relaxation, and improve sleep quality. Bioactive constituents of Sea Lavender include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are known to have anti-cancer, anti-viral, and anti-bacterial effects.
